text: 法国第三季度失业率略有下降，这给正面临抗议活动和预算不确定性等不利因素、并濒临衰退的经济带来些许缓解。法国统计部门Insee表示，第三季度失业率从上一季度的8.3%降至8.2%，预期为升至8.4%。法国央行周一表示，经济增速将在2026年最后一个季度“温和”回升，但同时警告称，存在异常高的不确定性，未给出精确的估计。Insee的数据显示，15-24岁人群的失业率下降至21%，而50岁以上人群的失业率略微上升至5.6%，为2022年初以来的最高水平。
text_en: France's unemployment rate edged down in the third quarter, offering some relief to an economy that is facing headwinds including protests and budget uncertainty and is on the brink of recession. French statistics agency Insee said the unemployment rate fell to 8.2% in the third quarter from 8.3% in the previous quarter, against expectations of a rise to 8.4%. The Bank of France said on Monday that economic growth would pick up "moderately" in the final quarter of 2026, but warned that uncertainty was unusually high and did not provide a precise estimate. Insee data showed that the unemployment rate for people aged 15-24 fell to 21%, while the unemployment rate for people over 50 rose slightly to 5.6%, the highest level since early 2022.
